# Cadasto Plugin Marketplace

> Plugins that teach Claude Code and Cursor a specific job: openEHR modelling,
> spec-driven development, Go and PHP standards, and documentation. Add the
> marketplace once in Claude Code. Each install is the release tag the catalog
> pins. Cursor installs each plugin from its own repository.

Cadasto B.V. maintains the catalog. The marketplace name is `cadasto`. Claude
Code installs a plugin as `<plugin>@cadasto` after
`/plugin marketplace add Cadasto/plugin-marketplace`. The source of truth for
which release is current is `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` in
[Cadasto/plugin-marketplace](https://github.com/Cadasto/plugin-marketplace).

## Documentation

- [Home](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/): the plugins, the two install paths, and the add command.
- [Quick start](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/quick-start/): add the marketplace in Claude Code and install one plugin.
- [Choose](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/choose/): which plugin matches which job, and what each one needs.
- [Plugins](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/): every catalog entry, its pinned tag, and its description.
- [openEHR Assistant](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/openehr-assistant/): archetypes, templates, compositions, AQL, CKM, and specification lookup.
- [openEHR Assistant Dev](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/openehr-assistant-dev/): maintainer tools for the openEHR Assistant server and plugin.
- [Go coding standards](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/go-coding/): Go formatting, errors, concurrency, testing, and layout.
- [PHP coding standards](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/php-coding/): PHP 8.4, PER Coding Style, and PHPStan level 8.
- [Spec-driven development](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/sdd/): requirements, RFC-2119 specifications, ADRs, traceability, and delivery.
- [Docs editing](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/plugins/docs-editing/): technical writing, copy editing, marketing copy, SEO, and AI citability.
- [Install](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/install/): add, update, inspect, Cursor, and a local working copy.
- [Contributing](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/contributing/): build the site locally and where a change belongs.
- [Contact](https://cadasto.github.io/plugin-marketplace/contact/): Cadasto B.V. email, the reseller sales route, and registered details.

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Cadasto/plugin-marketplace/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): catalog releases.
- [Cadasto](https://www.cadasto.com/)
